Wall legend (slice S4)

These are screenshots of the real app, built from branch s4-thin-walls, with real test parts loaded. Nothing here is drawn by hand.

What changes on the screen

  • One new legend row: a checkbox, a swatch and the words "Walls checked, no finding". The swatch colour is new: walnut brown #6b5d4f. Its contrast is 6.36:1 on the panel and 5.24:1 on the 3D view.
  • Walls are painted first, so any face that is also part of a hole, pocket or corner keeps that colour.
  • The verdict line counts walls, for example "1 pocket, 4 corners and 8 walls checked".
  • A wall finding reads "Wall 0.040 in thick (limit 0.060 in)". The line under it reads "wall-6 · 0.040 in thick · limit: estimate", then the suggestion "Make the wall 0.060 in or thicker if the design allows."
  • Selecting a wall finding turns both of its faces blue, fades everything else and frames the faces, just like the other findings.

Your choice: should "Walls checked, no finding" start ticked?

Almost every flat face of a part belongs to a wall. A plain block has 3 walls (its X, Y and Z pairs of faces), and those cover all 6 faces. With the box ticked, nearly the whole part turns brown (first picture). With it unticked, the part stays grey and only holes, pockets, corners and findings are coloured (second picture).

  1. Unticked when the page opens (recommended). The part stays readable, and you tick the box when you want to see which walls were measured. This is the only box that starts unticked. The risk: you once read untinted holes as missed (D-014), and grey walls could read the same way, though the verdict line still says "8 walls checked". It is a one-line change in the page.
  2. Ticked when the page opens, the same as the holes, pockets and corners boxes (D-015).

Reply with approve (with 1 or 2), change (and what), or rethink.
